title: Apply an Artifact-backed patch inside declared ProjectProfile globs

projectRef.description: Registered workspace project. This build ships `demo-app` (the WaterFlow OpenHarmony app) and `ArkDeck` (this repository); which one a host offers depends on how its daemon was configured.

patchArtifactRef.description: Lease of the unified diff to apply, in the form `lease-v1:<jobId>:<artifactId>` from `arkdeck artifact import-workspace-patch`. Arbitrary local paths are rejected.

allowedFileGlobs.description: Paths the patch may touch, and it may not touch anything outside them. Narrower than the project profile's own globs, never wider — the request cannot widen its own scope.

expectedWorkspaceRevision.description: Workspace revision the caller decided against; the provider refuses if the tree moved.
